## Activity

During November 2021, Market Eye Clinic recorded 417 captures. Activity was completed during the month, with the available records indicating that imaging proceeded as expected. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Image quality

There were 24 ungradable captures. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.8 per cent. The result should be considered alongside the overall activity for November 2021 and monitored through routine site review.

## Grading

A total of 82 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 8 days. These figures provide the monthly position for Market Eye Clinic and should support ongoing monitoring of image quality, grading activity and turnaround.
